title: Cross-Lingual Dialogue Dataset Creation via Outline-Based Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Quantifying 'translationese' artifacts (source language syntactic and lexical biases) by measuring the semantic similarity of sentence embeddings between the English source text and target language translations, and comparing downstream model performance on translated versus outline-generated evaluation sets.

Conducting human quality surveys to evaluate the naturalness of dialogues and the familiarity of mentioned entities and concepts, and analyzing the manual cultural adaptation of slot values (e.g., replacing Anglo-centric proper names and scenarios with locally relevant ones).
